payload.name: Bidirectional Flow/Entrypoint and Ledger/Knowledge Import Cycles
payload.description: Importing host flow modules from container entrypoints or CLI layers, or introducing bidirectional imports between sandbox_executor.ledger and sandbox_executor.knowledge, creates circular import failures and breaks container/host boundary isolation.
symptoms: ImportError or AttributeError on partially initialized modules during CLI or entrypoint startup
AST import guard failures in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_import_cycle.py or apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_entrypoint_imports.py
Container entrypoint scripts pulling in host-only flow orchestration dependencies
root_causes: Importing sandbox_executor.flow symbols directly inside sandbox_executor.entrypoint or sandbox_executor.cli modules
Cross-importing between sandbox_executor.ledger and sandbox_executor.knowledge instead of keeping ledger as a lower-level dependency
Placing shared data types or helpers in high-level orchestration modules instead of leaf modules

mitigations.description: Move shared constants, schemas, and pure helpers into low-level leaf modules that neither flow nor entrypoint owns.
Run apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_import_cycle.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_entrypoint_imports.py on every change to block new entrypoint-to-flow or ledger-to-knowledge edges.
